assistworld-assist-world:lever:7f103914-.title: EA / Operations Assistant (AI-Native)
assistworld-assist-world:lever:7f103914-.description: About Us We’re supporting a venture-backed startup helping some of the world's most innovative consumer technology companies optimize their products through AI-driven experimentation. They design and deploy experiments that improve user experience, increase engagement, and drive revenue growth. They're a small, ambitious team of five people who move quickly, value craftsmanship, and care deeply about building exceptional products. We believe in high ownership, high standards, and using technology to amplify human capability. The Role We're looking for an exceptionally capable Executive Assistant / Operations Associate to become a force multiplier for our founder. This isn't a traditional EA role. One day you might be coordinating international travel and researching the best neighborhood to stay in for a customer visit. The next, you could be sourcing catering for a private industry event, preparing customer documents, managing outreach campaigns, or helping streamline internal operations. You'll work across both professional and personal logistics, helping eliminate operational bottlenecks so leadership can stay focused on building the company. If you're someone who thrives on solving problems, figuring things out independently, and leveraging AI tools to move faster than everyone else, you'll love this role.

You deliver #bestincenter service, a company-wide standard for excellence in service, by sharing specialized knowledge in pastry techniques, baking fundamentals, and personalized instruction that supports all company initiatives. The Chef Instructor, Pastry plays a key role in inspiring a love for baking while driving sales of bakeware, mixers, and decorating tools through hands-on pastry classes and engaging culinary instruction. Operations & Compliance · Ensure compliance with food safety standards, local health codes, and sanitation regulations. · Properly handle all tools, ingredients, and kitchen equipment to maintain a safe and efficient work environment. · Maintain accurate inventory levels, minimize shrink, and control supply and culinary expenses. · May handle liquor, wine, and beer in compliance with state and location alcohol regulations, company policies, including enforcing age restrictions. · Ensure store safety and cleanliness, addressing any maintenance needs promptly. · Adhere to applicable wage and hour laws. gendigital-gen-digital:ashbyhq:cdff49f3-.description: ABOUT GEN: Gen is a global company dedicated to powering Digital Freedom through its trusted consumer brands including Norton, Avast, LifeLock, MoneyLion and more. Our combined heritage is rooted in financial empowerment and cyber safety for the first digital generations, and today we deliver award-winning cybersecurity, online privacy, identity protection and financial wellness solutions to nearly 500 million users in more than 150 countries. Together, we share a collective passion and vision to protect consumers and help them grow, manage and secure their digital and financial lives. We’re always looking for smart, fearless and high-impact talent who see AI as a teammate – leveraging it to move faster and deliver meaningful results. When you’re part of Gen, you’ll have the flexibility, tools and support to do your best work and grow your career – from flexible working options and time off to competitive pay, benefits and well-being programs. At Gen, we are scrappy and relentlessly customer driven. We create room for healthy debate, experimentation and continuous learning, and we seek out people with different experiences, identities and ideas to join our team. You’ll work with people who back each other, respect each other and understand that our differences are a competitive advantage. If this sounds like you, we’d love you to be part of Gen. ABOUT THE ROLE Gen is seeking an adaptable, high‑impact Contract Recruiter to support hiring needs across Tempe, Arizona; New York City, New York; and Mountain View, California. This role manages a consistent requisition load of approximately 20–30 mid‑ to senior‑level roles, spanning professional, corporate, and technical functions based on evolving business needs. The role is hybrid and based out of the Tempe, AZ or NYC office (3 days per week onsite), partnering closely with hiring managers and senior stakeholders across all three locations. The ideal candidate brings strong full‑cycle recruiting experience, demonstrates flexibility across role types, and is comfortable shifting between professional and technical searches in a fast‑paced environment. This recruiter operates with strong AI fluency, data literacy, and hands‑on experience using modern ATS platforms such as Ashby to drive sourcing efficiency, pipeline visibility, and informed decision‑making. With a consultative, solutions‑oriented approach, this role plays an important part in meeting hiring goals, advising leaders on talent markets, and delivering a high‑quality, high‑touch candidate experience in support of Gen’s broader talent strategy. jobgether-jobgether:lever:294a86d4-8336-.title: PR Lead
jobgether-jobgether:lever:294a86d4-8336-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a PR Lead based in United Kingdom. This is a senior individual contributor role with ownership of the public relations strategy for an ambitious, fast-growing AI and creator technology business. You’ll shape how the brand, products, technology, and creators are positioned across influential media and cultural conversations. A major focus will be on the U.S. market, making strong relationships with North American journalists essential to success. You’ll combine strategic communications planning with hands-on execution, from developing narratives and pitching stories to preparing executives for media opportunities. The role offers significant influence over brand visibility, credibility, awareness, and global expansion. You’ll work closely with senior leadership, Marketing, Product, and creator-focused teams in a highly dynamic and often ambiguous environment. It’s an exciting opportunity for a well-connected PR professional who knows how to turn emerging trends, products, and cultural moments into compelling stories. Own and execute the overall PR strategy across brand, product, technology, creators, and major company milestones. Build and maintain strong, long-term relationships with influential journalists and media contacts, particularly across U.S. technology, entertainment, lifestyle, and creator economy publications. Develop and pitch compelling stories designed to secure impactful coverage in leading media outlets. Identify timely news hooks, cultural trends, emerging conversations, and reactive opportunities that align with the brand and its strategic objectives. Create high-quality communications materials, including press releases, media pitches, talking points, FAQs, briefing documents, and reactive statements. Collaborate closely with Marketing, Product, Creator Partnerships, and senior leadership to identify stories, coordinate announcements, and maximize media opportunities. Serve as a trusted media advisor to executives, founders, and creators, preparing them for interviews, public appearances, and other media engagements. Develop compelling narratives around AI, entertainment, creator technology, and emerging digital experiences. Monitor media coverage, sentiment, reach, and other PR performance indicators, using insights to refine strategy and demonstrate impact. Respond quickly and strategically to breaking news, cultural moments, and opportunities that can increase awareness and credibility. Balance long-term brand building with short-term media opportunities that generate measurable awareness, traffic, and engagement. Contribute to the expansion of the organization's international media presence as it enters new markets. Requirements: 6+ years of professional experience in public relations, communications, or a closely related field, with a strong focus on U.S. media. Established relationships with journalists and editors across consumer technology, entertainment, creator economy, culture, or lifestyle media. Demonstrated ability to secure meaningful coverage in high-profile U.S. publications. Exceptional writing and storytelling skills, with the ability to create clear, persuasive, compelling, and brand-aligned communications. Strong strategic judgment and a proven ability to identify newsworthy angles, cultural moments, and compelling narratives. Demonstrated track record of delivering measurable PR and media results. Ability to operate as both a strategic communications leader and hands-on PR practitioner, personally writing pitches, developing materials, pursuing stories, and managing relationships. Excellent understanding of the U.S. media landscape and what makes stories relevant to different audiences and publications. summitwashholdings-summitwashholdings:le.description: IMPORTANT - REQUIRED NEXT STEP As part of our hiring process, all applicants are required to complete the Predictive Index (PI) Behavioral Assessment. The PI Behavioral Assessment is not a test, and there are no right or wrong answers. It helps us better understand your natural workplace preferences and behaviors. Please complete the assessment when prompted. Completion is required for your application to move forward in the review process. Benefits, and Perks - Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance - Flexible scheduling - Paid Time Off (PTO) - Career Growth based on Performance and not Seniority – 75% of employees were promoted within Summit Wash Holdings - Referral Bonus up to $800.00 per qualified hire, dependent on position - Free Car Wash Membership Who are we? Summit Wash Holdings is a premier group of car wash brands growing throughout the Northeast, Midwest, and Southeast regions. At Summit Wash Holdings, all teammates produce speedy service in a fun and mutually respectful manner with gold-standard integrity, quality, and hospitality, all while maintaining a work-life balance. Our Mission is to provide a fast, quality car wash with friendly-spirited engagement and integrity. What do we need? The Entry Ride Operator is the conductor and entertainer for our members while making sure all vehicles are being processed safely and efficiently into the car wash tunnel. The Entry Ride Operator interacts with all customers and is responsible for exterior site cleanliness and creating a memorable experience in all interactions while preparing the vehicles prior to entering the car wash tunnel. A successful candidate would love working outdoors in all conditions and will be excited to roll up their sleeves to get the job done! You must be highly motivated, have an outgoing, and a friendly personality. We will provide extensive hands-on and online training for all team members.
